# Lite edition licenses

Lite statically carries the pinned Bergamot runner and downloads the pinned
Firefox Translations model files described in this directory.

- `bergamot-9271618/MPL-2.0.txt` is the exact upstream Bergamot license.
- `bergamot-9271618/SOURCE-CODE.md` tells recipients where to obtain the
  corresponding Source Code Form and how to rebuild the shipped executable.
- `bergamot-9271618/STATIC_DEPENDENCIES.md` records the native dependency
  revisions and maps them to packaged license texts.
- `FIREFOX-TRANSLATIONS-MPL-2.0.txt` is copied from archived upstream revision
  `e7957fc407441a5e3e35bbcbf9d60d9b35764618`.
- `FIREFOX-TRANSLATIONS-MODELS.md` records every downloaded file and digest.
